sources.title: hoskasii/base-model · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Koko-TTS is an ultra-lightweight, high-fidelity Text-to-Speech (TTS) model with ~24.6M parameters. Built upon a Flow-Matching framework, it combines a Matcha-style UNet architecture conditioned on RoPE-based text representations with the highly efficient Vocos 24kHz neural vocoder. The model is designed for ultra-fast, real-time speech synthesis without compromising on audio quality.
